lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: That was close!  Man, they were really paranoid about being followed.

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: Shh!  We're not out of the woods yet.

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: Pun not intended.  Look, let's just put some more distance between us and them, then we can get some sleep and continue following their tracks in the morning
